description: Per-component size of the exported, arm64-thinned Threading.app, on disk and as raw deflate (what ditto -c -k writes). Lower sizes are accepted; growth past the noise allowance, or a new component, requires an intentional baseline update. See docs/architecture/releasing.md#the-bundle-size-ratchet.
